data.title: Cartier's latest creations honour the animal world
data.description: Cartier unveils a universe of wildlife that has long been part of the maison's creative world. Since the dawn of the 20th century, birds, insects, reptiles, felines and chimeras have inhabited Cartier's extraordinary fauna, presided over by the panther, the maison's emblematic creature. In its latest creations, alongside the panther, Cartier brings the tiger, parrot, carp, crocodile and rhinoceros to life through jewellery and watchmaking creations. Blending naturalism with imagination, each creation captures the distinctive anatomy and character of these creatures with a remarkable sense of life and movement. Behind every creation lies the savoir-faire of multiple métiers, from sculpting, engraving and polishing to intricate gem-setting. Every detail, from fur and scales to textures and movement, is meticulously interpreted, transforming each creation into a sculptural portrait of the animal world with Cartier's exceptional craftsmanship and unmistakable design language.
